_paper_context: These are the words for which emotion vectors were computed. The paper's own PCA over those vectors finds PC1 tracks valence/pleasure (r=0.81 against human ratings) and PC2 tracks arousal (r=0.66), 'coarsely reproducing the affective circumplex'. So this vocabulary is a LABEL layer over a valence/arousal geometry -- not a replacement for it. See docs/ai_research/2026-08-06_emotion_concepts_and_the_vad_question.md.
_usage_note: A vocabulary, not a taxonomy. The paper publishes no valence/arousal coordinates, no clustering, and no hierarchy for these words. Any structure this substrate attaches to them is ours and must be marked as ours.
